hero.main_text: Your study essentials, all in one place
hero.secondary_text: FMI-lib is your centralized platform for everything related to university. From GitHub repositories to personalized lessons, this is the place where you will find them.

about.title: About FMI-lib
about.description: FMI-lib is a bilingual resource library for students at the Faculty of Mathematics and Informatics.
about.mission_description: Our goal is to bring course materials and student-created lessons together in one clear, easy-to-browse place, so you can spend less time searching and more time learning.
about.materials_description: Browse materials organized by course, explore recommended repositories, and find lessons written for the website. Course pages link to their original sources and keep attribution close to the materials.
principles: Resources are organized by course and available in English and Romanian.
Materials stay linked to their original sources, with licensing and attribution respected.
The library grows through reviewed contributions from the student community.

contribute.title: Help make FMI-lib better
contribute.description: Useful course resources are easier for everyone to find when students share what they know. You can help by suggesting materials, writing a lesson, or improving existing information.

ways.title: Share course materials
ways.description: Suggest a public repository or resource that would help students in a specific course.

ways.title: Write a lesson
ways.description: Create a clear, original explanation or guide that helps students understand a topic.

ways.title: Improve the library
ways.description: Report outdated links, missing attribution, or course details that could be clearer.

steps: Choose a course and identify a resource or improvement that is useful to other students.
Share the source and its attribution, or prepare an original lesson in English or Romanian.
Propose the change through the project repository so it can be reviewed before publication.
contribute.guidelines: Only share resources you have permission to share. Link to original repositories instead of copying their files, respect licenses and attribution, and make sure lessons are your own work. Contributions are reviewed before they are published.
contribute.preview_description: Help fellow students by suggesting materials, writing a lesson, or improving course information.
